## 1

a\)

```{r}
# Formula: n(n + 1)/2

n <- 100

n*(n + 1)/2
```

b\)

```{r}
n <- 1000

n*(n + 1)/2
```

## 2

```{r}
n <- 1000
x <- seq(1, n)
sum(x)
```

## 3

`seq` creates a list of numbers and `sum` adds them up.

Answer: b

```{r}

```

a\)


```{r}

```

## 33

```{r}
# Sum from n = 1 to 100
sum(1 / (1:100)^2)
```

```{r}
# 1 (which is 1/1^2) plus the sum of reciprocals of squares from n = 2 to 100
1 + sum(1 / (seq(2, 100, 1)^2))
```
